NBA Debut: November 1, 1996

Career Length: 17 years

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Marcus Camby?

Marcus Camby is 52 years old.

Where was Marcus Camby born?

Marcus Camby was born in Hartford, Connecticut.

When was Marcus Camby born?

Marcus Camby was born on March 22, 1974.

How tall is Marcus Camby?

Marcus Camby is 6-11 (211 cm) tall.

How much did Marcus Camby weigh when playing?

Marcus Camby weighed 220 lbs (99 kg) when playing.

Is Marcus Camby in the Hall of Fame?

Marcus Camby is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Marcus Camby drafted?

Marcus Camby was drafted by Toronto Raptors, 1st round (2nd pick, 2nd overall), 1996 NBA Draft.

What position did Marcus Camby play?

Center and Power Forward.

When did Marcus Camby retire?

Marcus Camby last played in 2013.

What is Marcus Camby's net worth?

Marcus Camby made at least $130,044,549 playing professional basketball.

How much did Marcus Camby make?

Marcus Camby made $11,749,832 in 2011.

What did Marcus Camby average?

Marcus Camby averaged 9.5 points, 9.8 rebounds, and 1.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Marcus Camby have?

Marcus Camby won 0 championships.

What schools did Marcus Camby attend?

Marcus Camby attended Conard in West Hartford, Connecticut, Hartford Public in Hartford, Connecticut and UMass.

What are Marcus Camby's nicknames?

The Camby Man, Marcus Can't Be, MC are nicknames for Marcus Camby.
